purpose: Record which attention, mint, enrichment, replay, and alert sources are approved for the observation-only narrative radar.

sources.reason: Official dynamic-topic discovery feed; configured WOEIDs are explicit and bounded.
sources.limitations: Availability and cost depend on the X API plan; a trend has no trading authority.

sources.reason: Official, targeted confirmation of the highest-ranked discovered terms.
sources.limitations: Disabled by default to control spend and query amplification; does not prove organic attention.

sources.reason: Useful for approved term and account watchlists after stream-rule ownership and cost limits are designed.
sources.limitations: Not part of the current polling worker and no implicit KOL or wallet list may be installed.

sources.reason: Topic-level aggregated social discovery across multiple named upstream networks.
sources.limitations: Counts are provider aggregates and collapse to one social evidence channel to prevent fake source diversity.

sources.reason: Broad event and product-news discovery with shared entity extraction.
sources.limitations: Publisher coverage, licensing, delay, and plan limits vary; headlines are not popularity measurements.

sources.reason: Operator-approved company and newsroom feeds add attributable event discovery without a vendor key.
sources.limitations: Only explicit HTTPS feeds are read; local and reserved network targets are rejected.

sources.reason: Targeted news confirmation for a bounded number of already-discovered entities.
sources.limitations: Disabled by default; broad discovery and GDELT article counts are not treated as market demand.

sources.reason: The official API is an access-limited alpha and should be integrated only after the project is admitted.
sources.limitations: Search interest is usually confirmation rather than a slot-level launch trigger.

sources.reason: Official access can support retrospective meme-format research.
sources.limitations: Eligibility is restricted and newly published videos may take up to 48 hours to enter search results, so it is not a live trigger.

sources.reason: May provide targeted video confirmation after query quotas and channel provenance are bounded.
sources.limitations: Search requests have material quota cost and popularity can be manipulated.

sources.reason: Community signals require an approved developer integration and explicit subreddit scope.
sources.limitations: The production design does not scrape unauthenticated .json endpoints or assume legacy Data API access.

sources.reason: Arbitrary-term social volume can support replay and corroboration when licensed.
sources.limitations: Metric access and intervals are plan-dependent and some data can be supplemented later; not a latency-critical trigger.

sources.reason: Canonical Pump program log discovery is integrated with bounded queues, retries, and event-time provenance.
sources.limitations: Reconnect gaps are recorded but not yet backfilled; logs alone do not identify the mint without transaction resolution.

sources.reason: Canonical mint identity and metadata are resolved after a Pump event.
sources.limitations: Fresh metadata may lag and absence causes an explicit enrichment failure rather than fabricated fields.

sources.reason: Adds current pair links, attached social links, and liquidity when a matching Solana pair exists.
sources.limitations: Optional provider enrichment; pair data cannot establish canonical lifecycle stage or social authenticity.

sources.reason: Uses the existing single-chat, observation-only alert path.
sources.limitations: Best-effort delivery with no durable outbox; Telegram commands and execution are not implemented.

sources.reason: Suitable for historical cohort construction and cross-checking after a point-in-time replay contract is implemented.
sources.limitations: Historical convenience data must not leak future state into decisions.

sources.reason: Useful for aggregate historical calibration and market-regime research.
sources.limitations: Query refresh lag and mutable SQL make it unsuitable as the canonical live trigger.

sources.reason: The supplied frontend routes are undocumented application internals, so the engine uses canonical Pump logs plus Helius metadata instead.
sources.limitations: Paths, response fields, availability, and access policy can change without a public integration contract.

sources.reason: GetXAPI and SocialData were not selected for the production path because provenance, terms, and response semantics were not established.
sources.limitations: May be reassessed separately; credentials must not be added before that review.

sources.reason: TrendsAPI and Apify scraper suggestions were not selected for the production path.
sources.limitations: Scraper stability, consent, provenance, and platform terms require a separate review.

sources.reason: The supplied host and endpoint semantics were not established from authoritative documentation.
sources.limitations: A failed or paywalled request is not evidence of a supported production API.
